reviews.title: NO FREE VERSION
reviews.text:
I’m not going to gripe about having to pay to use a product someone toiled over to create. But I thought there was a free version.

There isn’t. 

The only screen when I open the app offers a free trial for three days. There’s no way of getting around this screen without outright purchasing it or doing the free trial. 

If you want to charge for it, fine! I don’t begrudge you that. But don’t make it an “In-app purchases available”, just state the price. You’ll avoid lots of one-star reviews.

reviews.title: Predatory Billing
reviews.text:
Aggressive billing of $10 per week if you sign up for the free trial. I don’t even remember agreeing for a weekly billing of $10/week, which is $520/yr mind you, for some basic audio editor. I only found out after 2 weekly payments, and requested a refund immediately. I was denied refund for both payments, despite not even opening the app once after the first day. I only used it to cut like 3 seconds of silence from a 2 minute voice memo. That’s it, and $20 gone.

Horrible customer service, predatory billing, don’t recommend
